items.title: Bob Coquille Interview, 1978-11-15
items.q: I was there eight months with Nicky's Last Straws.

ctx.x: Well, some people just don't appreciate what good time is, either.

Now, some band leaders, some band leaders let the trombone player go. Now, that was the case with The Last Straws when we went to Famous Goat some time back. They cut all three bands down. At the Famous Store right now, we have three bands, seven days a week, all year round, seven nights a week. First band comes on at 12, 15 to 5. We have the middle shift now. We used to have the night shift for many years. In fact, this is the first time in my life. I get home at 10.30 at night. Now, I'm used to getting home at…
And now they have different bands. Now there's three five piece bands there now.
